scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/subset-fonts.mjs && node scripts/measure-site.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm test:contact && pnpm build && node scripts/check-site.mjs
scripts.contact:dev: wrangler pages dev dist --d1 CONTACT_DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --binding CONTACT_ENABLED=false --binding CONTACT_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8788 --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.contact:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply CONTACT_DB --local --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.contact:check: wrangler pages functions build --outdir .wrangler/contact-check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" --config workers/contact-jobs/wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --config workers/contact-jobs/wrangler.toml
